method: RI-WLD04 M18 — differentiation measured on the built world
note: Replaces region-axes@1, in which 8 of 9 axes were string or hex comparisons against game/data/world/regions.json (verdict W1-01 §4d). Every axis here names its source; 7 are measured off built geometry or replicated renderer placement and 2 off rendered pixels. Unmeasurable axes are dropped, not scored.

axes.source: built terrain (heightAt mean and p10-p90 spread)
built water (depthAt at all four tide phases)
renderer ground shader replicated over built ground and built depth (CIELAB dE)
province.js prop lattice replicated: instances the renderer places
same lattice: placed crown height and radius, not the table row
rendered pixels: mean CIELAB of the region’s M17 frames, top and upper-middle bands
rendered pixels: the sky/canopy/ground CIELAB profile down the frame

dropped_axes.reason: no enemy or creature is placed in any region in this build; a fauna axis scored off a table row would read 78/78 on an empty province
two interiors exist against a declared 250, and no per-region architecture is placed in the exterior; there is nothing built to measure
getWorldStats() reports audioMB 0. There is no audio in this build at all (verdict W1-01 §4d)
weather is a per-frame capture parameter, not a property of the built world; it enters through rendered_palette when the M17 night and worst-weather passes are captured
hazards exist as a census and were shown not to fire (verdict W1-01, RI-WLD11 30/100); until they do, a hazard axis measures a table
